newsitem.title: USA: SPX says commences tender offer for notes.
newsitem.headline: SPX says commences tender offer for notes.

text.p: SPX Corp said it commenced a tender offer to purchase for cash all of its outstanding 11-3/4-percent senior subordinated notes due 2002, with about $128.4 million in principal amount.

The company said it will purchase the outstanding notes at a price determined by a fixed spread of 35 basis points over the yield to maturity of certain U.S. Treasury notes plus accrued and unpaid interest within certain limits.
The tender offer will expire at 1700 EST/2200 GMT on April 9, unless extended or terminated earlier, SPX said.
SPX makes car tools and parts.
